accessInterpretation.anonymousGuard: 131 deliberately grants anon/authenticated/service_role EXECUTE on public.rpc_closure_api_guard() for PostgREST pre-request.143's body is a guard and read-path allowance, not an anonymous business writer.
accessInterpretation.serviceBudgetPath: 127 explicitly pins pg_catalog, public, private; the RPC remains service-only. Other240 inspected overloads pin pg_catalog.
accessInterpretation.priorDualRoleEndpoints: Historical authenticated/service_role grants were preserved on the additional11 prior-source functions. Generic service-name classification was not used to mislabel preserved ACLs as a regression.
